Message:
ALSA: usb-audio: scarlett2: Label 18i8 Gen 3 line outputs correctly

The 18i8 Gen 3 analogue 7/8 outputs are identified as line 3/4 on the
rear of the unit. Add support for remapping the channel numbers to
match the labelling.
